goals.title: Keep listing-to-product sync success at 95%+
goals.description: products_upserted / items_seen; below 80% means mapping or DB adapter drift. Generic engine (specpicks instance does the running). Metric binding code-verified in run(), unverified by a recorded run on this registration.
directives: Investigate mapping.py when the rate dips below 80% for two runs

goals.title: Sustain product upsert throughput
goals.description: Fresh eBay listings feeding the destination DB each run. Metric binding code-verified, unverified by a recorded run.
directives: Cover all configured seed categories before deepening any single one

goals.title: Zero sync errors per run
goals.description: errors_count>0 usually means OAuth token, rate limit, or schema drift. Metric binding code-verified, unverified by a recorded run.
directives: Classify errors (auth vs rate-limit vs data) in the run summary so the operator can act
